BFF_OFFLINE: Local BFF is offline; fell back to Mock generation
INVALID_CURSOR: Invalid pagination cursor; returned to first page
INVALID_DIMENSIONS: Custom resolution is out of range
FILE_REQUIRED: Please choose an image to upload
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests, please retry later
INTERNAL_ERROR: Server error, check the BFF log
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Only PNG / JPEG / WebP images are supported
AGENT_BUSY: This session is running; wait or cancel first
PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Provider has no API key configured
PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED: API key is invalid or lacks permission
PROVIDER_BAD_REQUEST: Provider rejected the request: invalid parameters
PROVIDER_NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the provider, check your network
MODEL_EXISTS: Model is already in the catalog
MODEL_IN_USE: Model is a default route; change the route first
MODEL_NOT_READY: Model is not enabled. Enable it in the model catalog first
MODEL_MISSING: Model was delisted; re-fetch or pick another
MODEL_MODE_UNSUPPORTED: The selected model doesn't support this mode. Pick another model
MODEL_ROUTE_INVALID: Model is disabled, delisted, or doesn't support this mode
MODEL_DISCOVERY_AUTH: Model list authentication failed, check the API key
MODEL_DISCOVERY_NETWORK: Could not fetch the model list, check your network
WORK_FILE_MISSING: Work file is missing or already cleaned
ASSET_PROJECT_MISMATCH: This asset belongs to another project. Move it to the current project first
ASSET_IN_USE: A running task is using this asset; delete it later
ASSET_REFERENCED: Asset is referenced by past works; confirm before deleting
TASK_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only finished tasks can be retried
